description: The §14.28 setup layer's pure decision surface (D-049): the command validators (tenant, user, limits — the SETUP_* refusal family, shapes decided BEFORE any statement), the role ladder as data, and the wizard's remainingSteps derivation (§14.10's first-run states are DATA, never decoration). Pure and deterministic — the timezone allowlist is injected, the unique-key collisions are the database's to surface by name, the credential's policy floor is the auth module's (the adapter runs it). The SQL executor is @sentinel/db's makeSetupAdapter (the founder SECURITY DEFINER door is 0010_setup's); the transport is the /api/setup routes; the screens are /setup.
